title: Revenue Operations & Commercial Automation
summary: Automated the end-to-end commercial pipeline from lead intake to automated invoicing and receivables tracking, eliminating manual spreadsheet updates and creating clear hand-offs between sales, project delivery, and finance.

projectItems.title: Zoho CRM & Business Development Lifecycle Automation
projectItems.summary: Built a structured CRM workflow covering lead intake, qualification, proposal creation, SOW generation, project team handover, sales order processing, automated invoicing, and receivables tracking.
projectItems.problemStatement: Deals were getting delayed or mismanaged because sales leads, proposal versions, and SOW approvals were tracked manually across Excel files and email threads. Sales had no standard pipeline stages, finance couldn't see what deals were closed, and project handovers were verbal, causing missed requirements.
projectItems.solution: Configured Zoho CRM Blueprints with mandatory validation rules at each deal stage. Built custom Creator modules for generating standardized SOW proposals with manager sign-offs. Integrated CRM with Zoho Books to trigger automatic invoice generation upon Sales Order approval. Set up real-time CRM dashboards tracking pipeline value, deal conversion rates, and receivables ageing.
projectItems.impact: Saved approximately 15 hours per month across 6 core users by eliminating duplicate data entry, manual status updates, and email follow-ups. Gave management clear, real-time pipeline visibility for accurate revenue forecasting.
projectItems.keyTakeaway: Connects commercial sales workflows directly with finance and project delivery systems, ensuring full transparency from initial client contact to payment collection.
